title: AugustaMC
description: Towny Survival Server with Quests, Jobs, Ranks, and More! Both Java and Bedrock Compatible. Join today!
body:
# Welcome to AugustaMC
A **Towny Survival experience** where your goal is simple:  
Build a town, grow your wealth, and rise to the top of the server.

## Our Features
### 🏘️ **Towny** - Land Claims
↳ Join a town or create your own in our **custom world**  
↳ Team up with friends and build alliances

### 📜 **1,500+ Quests**
↳ Complete hundreds of quests across many categories  
↳ Unlock **powerful perks and rewards** as you progress  
↳ Always have a new objective to work toward

### ⬆️ **Ranks & Progression**
↳ Climb through the ranks and unlock new advantages  
↳ Reach **Rank 50** and prove your dominance  
↳ Each rank makes you stronger and more efficient

### 💰 **Player-Driven Economy**
↳ Make money through **jobs, chest shops, farms, or trading**  
↳ Build businesses and dominate the market  
↳ Discover the best strategy to become the **richest player**

### 🎣 **Custom Features**
↳ Custom Fishing, MCMMO, Cosmetics, and more  
↳ **Weekly Challenges** keep the server fresh and competitive  
↳ New goals, new metas, and new rewards every week

The question is simple:  
**Will you build a small town… or an empire?**

## ⭐Join AugustaMC
⛏️IP: mod.augustamc.com

💬Discord: [discord.gg/augustamc](https://discord.gg/augustamc)
